name: Dynamic college persona loader (50-school coverage)
acceptanceCriteria: /college-interviews page has a 'Don't see your school?' section beneath the school grid
That section contains a text input and a 'Generate' button
The helper copy mentions that it works for any US/Canadian/UK university
Input placeholder suggests examples like 'University of Toronto, Oxford, UBC'
When the Generate button is clicked with valid input, a loading state appears (button label changes to 'Generating…')
After success, a confirmation line appears stating the generated interviewer is being used (quality note included)
antiPatterns: Generate button active with empty input
No visible feedback after clicking Generate
Error text rendered in plain white (should be contrasted / red)

screenshots.expect: The college interview setup page with the school grid and the 'Don't see your school?' dynamic persona section visible
